description: Converted Hypertext d20 base classes for Airship Engineer, Air Captain, and Sky Warden.

entries.title: Airship Engineer
entries.summary: A complete twenty-level Hypertext d20 technical class for repair, temporary gadgets, prototypes, and airship engineering.
body: Airship Engineers keep vessels, weapons, workshops, and improvised machinery operating when a routine failure can kill an entire crew.
The class is a non-spellcasting technical specialist whose power comes from tools, preparation, an Intelligence-based ingenuity reserve, and one of three engineering paths.

sections.heading: Class chassis
body: Hit Die d8; average base attack; good Reflex and Will saves; 6 + Intelligence modifier skill points per level, multiplied by four at 1st level.

Class skills: Appraise, Balance, Climb, Concentration, Craft, Decipher Script, Disable Device, Knowledge (arcana), Knowledge (architecture and engineering), Knowledge (geography), Knowledge (local), Profession, Search, Spellcraft, Use Magic Device, and Use Rope.
Proficient with simple weapons, one martial weapon chosen at 1st level, and light armor.

sections.heading: Twenty-level progression
body: Levels 1–5: Tinker’s Expertise and schematic book; Engineer’s Ingenuity and Rapid Repair; engineering path I; bonus technical feat; prototype device.
Levels 6–10: efficient fabrication; engineering path II; bonus technical feat; advanced schematics; emergency rebuild.
Levels 11–15: engineering path III; bonus technical feat; reliable devices; greater prototype; engineering path IV.
Levels 16–20: bonus technical feat; master repair; integrated systems; engineering path V; revolutionary design. Base attack reaches +15; good saves reach +12; poor Fortitude reaches +6.

sections.heading: Core features
body: Tinker’s Expertise: Choose two Craft or Profession specialties. Gain +2 competence, increasing to +4 at 9th and +6 at 17th level; Knowledge (architecture and engineering) may be used untrained.

Schematic Book: Know three schematics at 1st level and one more at every odd class level. One hour of work creates up to 2 + Intelligence modifier active temporary gadgets, minimum 1. They last 24 hours, until expended, or until dismantled.

Engineer’s Ingenuity: Beginning at 2nd level, gain points equal to class level + Intelligence modifier, minimum 1, restored after eight hours of rest and maintenance. Spend 1 point to activate a gadget, gain +2 insight on an appropriate technical check, or power Rapid Repair.

Rapid Repair: As a standard action adjacent to an object, construct, vehicle, or ship zone, spend 1 point to restore 1d6 + class level + Intelligence modifier hit points. At 17th level restore 2d6 instead and repair one disabled minor subsystem if replacement materials worth 100 gp are available.
Engineering Path: At 3rd level choose Ship Engineer, Sky Machine Engineer, or Tinker Engineer; gain path features at 3rd, 7th, 11th, 15th, and 19th levels.

Prototype Device: At 5th level, one hour and parts worth 25 gp per class level create a 24-hour prototype. Choose a 10-foot +2 deflection field, a 20-foot personal or 25-percent vessel speed booster, or an auto-repair module restoring 2 hit points per class level over 10 rounds. One may be active; two at 14th level.
Emergency Rebuild: At 10th level spend 3 points and a full-round action to operate one disabled but not destroyed device or ship component for 10 minutes per class level at -2 on related checks.

Revolutionary Design: At 20th level designate one personal item, system, or prototype. Treat its invention complexity as one category lower, grant it one free improvement, and reduce its first catastrophic failure to a major failure.

sections.heading: Conversion status
body: Converted and ready for homebrew playtesting. Class ability save DCs equal 10 + one-half class level + Intelligence modifier unless stated otherwise.

Source proficiency scaling, advantage, bonus-action timing, and short-rest recharge have been replaced with d20 base attack, Fortitude/Reflex/Will saves, typed bonuses, standard/swift/immediate actions, and daily resources.

entries.title: Air Captain
entries.summary: A complete twenty-level Hypertext d20 martial leader class for command points, tactical orders, navigation, morale, and crew coordination.
body: Air Captains turn specialists into functioning crews through route knowledge, disciplined orders, morale, and decisive action.
The class is a trained martial leader using a Charisma-based command reserve and one of three paths: Sky Warlord, Explorer Captain, or Shipwright Captain.

sections.heading: Class chassis
body: Hit Die d10; good base attack; good Reflex and Will saves; 6 + Intelligence modifier skill points per level, multiplied by four at 1st level.

Class skills: Balance, Bluff, Climb, Diplomacy, Gather Information, Intimidate, Knowledge (geography), Knowledge (history), Knowledge (local), Knowledge (nobility and royalty), Listen, Profession (air sailor), Ride, Search, Sense Motive, Spot, Survival, Swim, and Use Rope.
Proficient with all simple and martial weapons, light and medium armor, and shields except tower shields.

sections.heading: Twenty-level progression
body: Levels 1–5: Commanding Presence, command points, tactical orders; Inspiring Command and Quick Maneuver; command path I; bonus leadership feat; Master Tactics.
Levels 6–10: expanded command aura; command path II; bonus leadership feat; coordinated action; Veteran Commander.
Levels 11–15: command path III; bonus leadership feat; decisive order; command reserve; command path IV.
Levels 16–20: bonus leadership feat; Legendary Orders; unbroken command; command path V; Master Tactician. Base attack reaches +20; good saves reach +12; poor Fortitude reaches +6.

sections.heading: Core features
body: Command Points: Gain points equal to class level + Charisma modifier, minimum 1, restored after eight hours of rest. Orders affect allies who can see or hear the captain and normally cost 1 point.

Tactical Orders: As a swift action, grant one ally within 30 feet one benefit for 1 round: Advance grants immediate movement up to 10 feet without provoking; Aim grants +2 competence on the next attack; Brace grants +2 dodge AC and Reflex; Assist grants +2 on the next skill check. Range becomes 60 feet at 6th and 120 feet at 17th level.

Airship Commander: Gain +2 competence on Profession (air sailor), Survival, and Knowledge (geography) for navigation or command. A successful route check can reduce ordinary travel time by 10 percent, to 20 percent at 10th level.

Inspiring Command: At 2nd level spend 1 point and a standard action; up to one ally per Charisma modifier within 30 feet gains temporary hit points equal to class level + Charisma modifier for 10 minutes per level.
Command Path: At 3rd level choose Sky Warlord, Explorer Captain, or Shipwright Captain; gain path features at 3rd, 7th, 11th, 15th, and 19th levels.
Master Tactics: At 5th level maintain two different orders at once. Coordinated Action at 9th level lets two allies receive one order for 1 additional point.

Legendary Orders: At 17th level spend 4 points and a standard action for a 30-foot group order lasting 1 round: All-Out Attack grants +2 morale on attacks and damage; Evasive Maneuvers grants +4 dodge AC and Reflex; Push Forward grants immediate movement up to half speed without provoking.
Master Tactician: At 20th level the first 1-point order each round is free, and one ally may maintain two different orders.

sections.heading: Conversion status
body: Converted and ready for homebrew playtesting. Class ability save DCs equal 10 + one-half class level + Charisma modifier unless stated otherwise.
Source advantage, bonus-action timing, and rest recharge have been converted into typed bonuses, swift or immediate actions, daily command points, and ordinary d20 action economy.

entries.title: Sky Warden
entries.summary: A complete twenty-level Hypertext d20 divine guardian class for fall prevention, healing, protective auras, aerial rescue, and celestial domains.
body: Sky Wardens defend crews from falls, violent winds, damaged vessels, magical storms, and abyssal threats.
The class is a supernatural defensive support class using a Wisdom-based skyward-energy reserve and one of three domains: Zephyr, Aether, or Stormcall.

sections.heading: Class chassis
body: Hit Die d8; average base attack; good Fortitude and Will saves; 4 + Intelligence modifier skill points per level, multiplied by four at 1st level.
Class skills: Concentration, Craft, Diplomacy, Heal, Knowledge (arcana), Knowledge (nature), Knowledge (religion), Listen, Profession (air sailor), Sense Motive, Spellcraft, Spot, and Survival.
Proficient with simple weapons, light and medium armor, and shields except tower shields.

sections.heading: Twenty-level progression
body: Levels 1–5: Abyssal Anchor, Sky’s Blessing, skyward energy; Channel Skyward Energy; celestial domain I; bonus defensive or divine feat; Aegis of the Sky.
Levels 6–10: greater channeling; celestial domain II; 20-foot aura; rescue step; protective dome.
Levels 11–15: celestial domain III; bonus defensive or divine feat; anchored soul; windborne rescue; celestial domain IV.
Levels 16–20: greater Aegis; 30-foot aura; celestial flight; celestial domain V; Guardian of the Open Sky. Base attack reaches +15; good saves reach +12; poor Reflex reaches +6.

sections.heading: Core features
body: Skyward Energy: Gain points equal to 3 + Wisdom modifier + one-half class level, minimum 1, restored after eight hours of rest and prayer.

Abyssal Anchor: As an immediate action and 1 point, protect one creature within 30 feet that is falling or forcibly moved. Its descent slows to 60 feet per round, it takes no falling damage, and may drift 5 feet horizontally for up to 5 rounds. Range becomes 60 feet at 9th level.

Sky’s Blessing: Allies within 10 feet take half falling and collision damage and gain +2 sacred on checks or saves against forced movement. Radius becomes 20 feet at 8th and 30 feet at 17th level; the bonus becomes +4 at 13th level.

Channel Skyward Energy: At 2nd level spend 1 point and a standard action. Healing Updraft restores 1d8 + Wisdom modifier + one-half class level hit points within 30 feet; Repelling Gust forces enemies in a 15-foot cone to pass Fortitude or be pushed 10 feet and take -2 AC until their next turn. At 6th level healing becomes 2d8 and the cone becomes 30 feet.
Celestial Domain: At 3rd level choose Zephyr, Aether, or Stormcall; gain domain features at 3rd, 7th, 11th, 15th, and 19th levels.

Aegis of the Sky: At 5th level spend 2 points and a standard action to create a 10-foot-radius dome for 5 rounds. Allies gain +2 deflection AC against ranged attacks, +2 resistance against wind, weather, and abyssal effects, and resist forced movement outside it. Radius becomes 20 feet and bonuses +3 at 10th; at 16th bonuses become +4, energy resistance 10 applies to cold, electricity, fire, and sonic, and duration becomes 10 rounds.
Celestial Flight: At 18th level gain fly 60 feet with good maneuverability for 10 minutes per class level each day, divided into 1-minute increments.

Guardian of the Open Sky: At 20th level the first skyward-energy point each round is free. Allies in Sky’s Blessing cannot be killed solely by falling damage; a lethal fall leaves them at -9 hit points and stable.

sections.heading: Conversion status
body: Converted and ready for homebrew playtesting. Class ability save DCs equal 10 + one-half class level + Wisdom modifier unless stated otherwise.
Source proficiency scaling, advantage, bonus-action timing, and rest recharge have been converted into d20 saves, typed bonuses, immediate or standard actions, and a daily supernatural resource.
